Beginner.learningGoal: Transform lists and maps with map, filter, groupBy, associate and fold.
gotchas: listOf is read-only, not immutable, and may be backed by a mutable list
associate keeps only the last value for duplicate keys
fold vs reduce on an empty list: reduce throws
goodSolutionShows: Standard library functions rather than manual loops
shapeHints: grouping orders by customer and summing
building a lookup of users by id

Intermediate.learningGoal: Use sortedWith, zip, windowed, chunked, partition and flatMap with explicit tie-breaking.
gotchas: sortedBy is stable but comparators must handle ties explicitly for deterministic output
windowed drops partial windows unless partialWindows = true
maxBy throws on empty in older versions; maxByOrNull is safe
goodSolutionShows: partition for a single pass split
windowed and chunked with the right flags
shapeHints: ranking players by score then name

Advanced.learningGoal: Understand eager vs lazy evaluation and write Sequence pipelines, including generateSequence and custom sequence builders.
gotchas: Sequence operations are evaluated per element so side effects interleave unlike lists
A sequence can be consumed more than once only if the source allows it
Terminal operation needed; without it nothing runs
goodSolutionShows: asSequence for large pipelines with early termination (take, first)
sequence { yield } builder for stateful generation
A test with a side-effect counter proving laziness
shapeHints: finding the first N primes lazily
a paginated source exposed as a Sequence with an injected page loader
deduplicating consecutive items in a stream
